shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "cat specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && printf '\\n--- lore ---\\n' && cat .lore/dod.md && printf '\\n--- commands ---\\n' && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files src test tests specs | head -100"

/bin/zsh -lc "pwd; rg --files | rg '("'^|/)(.*test.*|.*spec-links.*|test-commands.yml)$'"' | head -120; sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '1,230p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; cat .lore/test-commands.yml"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#|@spec|spec:\" src scripts .lore | head -100; sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/sessionSave.test.ts; cat package.json; rg -n \"lore_(list_tests|run_test)|dod\""
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; cat jest.config.js; ls .lore; rg -n \"specAnchor|spec-anchor|specs/\" src/**/*.test.ts | head -30"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short; git diff --check; git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "Add acceptance test for beforeSession failure hooks" && git push origin HEAD'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
